title: Hilltop Access Road, Kennewick, Washington

start.label: Road end
start.description: The south end of the road stub off W 47th Ave, at the foot of the hill - the access road continues from it

end.label: Hilltop
end.description: The top of the hill, 200 feet above the road end - a level site (for a water reservoir, say), with room to turn around

notes: An example road plan: a single-lane gravel access road for maintenance trucks, from the end of the road at the foot of a hill at the south edge of Kennewick to a site on the hilltop.
Keep the road's grade at or under 12%, and keep it off the house lots at the foot of the hill, west of the road end.
The plan illustrates Roadie on USGS lidar terrain - it isn't a proposed project.
